title: Surreal Gathering Scene
description: A group of people in a dimly lit room with a large bed, small tables, food, and objects including a gun and a clock. Above them swirls a giant orange moon with orbiting spheres, a floating figure in red cloth, and a large black bird flying through white clouds against a fiery sky.
prompt: A surreal painting shows several people gathered in a dark room around a large bed covered with a blue cloth and red fabric. A shirtless man draws at a table, a woman with a bun stands nearby, another couple sits on the bed, and a man stands behind them. On the tables are food, a gun, a clock, and other objects. In the swirling fiery sky above looms a giant glowing orange moon with smaller orbiting spheres, a floating man in red cloth, and a large black bird flies through white clouds.
